title: DISCERNING MINDS OR GENERIC TUTORS? EVALUATING INSTRUCTIONAL GUIDANCE CAPABILITIES IN SOCRATIC LLMS
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and validation of GuideEval, a benchmark for evaluating pedagogical and instructional guidance in Socratic LLMs. It does not evaluate religious, theological, or ethical frameworks as a component of its study; it only includes a standard ethics statement regarding the privacy and de-identification of the student-tutor dialogue data used.
